newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Lentex IPO heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Lentex IPO heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 6,316,817 shares of the 1.5-million-share initial public offering of Polish carpet maker Lentex SA, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.

Lentex said that in the large investor tranche of 900,000 shares the orders of National Investment Funds (NFIs), which under the issue prospectus could take up to 200,000 shares, were reduced by 43.7 percent.
Other preferred investors' orders were reduced by 78.8 percent while non-preferred investors in the large investor tranche had their orders reduced by 93.2 percent, it said.
Lentex said in the small investor 500,000-share tranche orders were reduced by 73 percent.
The management and employees took 71,959 shares of their 100,000-share tranche.
The shares, which were offered earlier in the month were priced at 21.5 zlotys per share.
The company, which seeks a main market listing, said earlier it was likely to enter the bourse in late March or early in April.
